answer: The system builds a cryptographic bridge between each agent’s identity thread and a secure vault that stores a stake of native tokens locked at registration. Every epoch the vault releases a tiny reward slice that vests linearly, so a new identity must wait many epochs to earn meaningful payoff. An attacker must front‑pay the full stake for every fake ID and endure the same vesting delay, making large‑scale Sybil farms economically prohibitive.
